cases.prompt: Write a Python function regex_match(s, p) implementing regular-expression matching where '.' matches any single character and '*' matches zero or more of the preceding element. The match must cover the ENTIRE input string. Return only the function in a Python code block.

Write a Python function word_break(s, words) that returns True if the string s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more words from the list `words` (each word reusable). The empty string returns True. Return only the function in a Python code block.

Write a Python function calculate(s) that evaluates a string arithmetic expression containing non-negative integers and the operators + - * / and spaces, with normal operator precedence and no parentheses. Division truncates toward zero. Return only the function in a Python code block.

Write a Python function trap(height) that, given a list of non-negative integers representing an elevation map where each bar has width 1, computes how much water it can trap after raining. Return only the function in a Python code block.

Write a Python function min_distance(a, b) returning the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, or substitutions needed to convert string a into string b (Levenshtein distance). Return only the function in a Python code block.
